I'd pick **Rossi Idraulica**. It costs less and has double the warranty.

| | Rossi | TermoCasa |
|---|---|---|
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR |
| Warranty | 10 yrs (yearly service) | 5 yrs |
| Timing | 2 weeks | Next week |

- TermoCasa's 3,400 EUR doesn't include VAT. With 22% VAT it comes to 4,148 EUR, which is 198 EUR more than Rossi.
- Rossi's 10-year warranty only holds if the boiler is serviced every year. Marta already does that each November.
- TermoCasa's quote doesn't say whether removing the old unit is included. Rossi's does.
- Before replacing anything, ask Marta whether a new expansion vessel would fix the pressure drop. Your boiler is only from 2019, so a repair could cost far less than either quote.

The report is in **vault/Projects/Research/2026-10-07-2151-boiler-replacement-quotes.md**, and I've committed it.
